# 📜 INFORMATION
 **razz's fabric pack** is my personal optimization and PvP focused modpack that aims on making the Vanilla experience more enjoyable.

This modpack uses **VulkanMod**, therefore, does NOT use or support **Sodium** (or any other similar mods).

# 🔼 COMPARISON
| Modpack             | Version             | Average FPS             |
|---------------------|:---------------------:|---------------------:|
| razz's fabric pack| 1.21.11| 412|
| Vanilla Minecraft| 1.21.11| 132|

**+312% MORE PERFORMANCE**

_All tests were done on 12 rendering chunks and 8 simulation chunks (using Intel I7 3770 and GTX 1050 TI 4GB) and while maintaining the same seed._

# 🔧 REQUIREMENTS
- Since this modpack uses **VulkanMod**, you are required to have a GPU that supports Vulkan 1.2 or higher.

- This modpack requires **[Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/)**.

# 📌 FAQ
**Q**: Can i add or remove mods from the modpack?

R: Yes, feel free to modify the modpack but beware of [incompatibilites with **VulkanMod**](https://github.com/xCollateral/VulkanMod/wiki/Incompatible-mods).

**Q**: Does this modpack requires an install on the server?

R: No, the modpack is client-sided.

**Q**: Will this modpack make me better at PvP?

R: No, but it will definetly make the frames better. :spongbob_sad:
